subject_definitions:
HIGHEST-PRIORITY VISUAL RULE: The entire video frame must remain completely free of visible language content from the first frame to the last frame. Spoken dialogue belongs exclusively to the audio track. Never display, write, draw, project, overlay, or reproduce any spoken words on screen.

<Picture 1> is the sole visual reference for the appearance and colors of the two characters, the medicine bottle, the bamboo grove, the physical actions, the composition, and the shot order. Transfer only these visual and narrative elements. Treat every printed element in <Picture 1> as nonexistent reference noise. Do not copy any title, dialogue writing, sound-effect writing, speech container, logo, footer, or decorative mark from <Picture 1>.

<Subject 1> (S1) is the short-haired traveler shown in <Picture 1>, with short dark hair, amber-brown eyes, a small black earring, black gloves, and a fitted black high-collared outfit with gray straps, belts, and metallic accessories. Voice anchor: female, young adult, medium-high pitch, lively clear voice.

<Subject 2> (S2) is the long-haired man shown in <Picture 1>, with long black hair tied into a high ponytail by a green band, pale gray eyes, a high white scarf, and layered gray, black, white, green, and red clothing with arm guards and decorative fasteners. He remains unmistakably male in every shot. Voice anchor: male, young adult, medium-low pitch, calm restrained voice.

The scene is a quiet green bamboo grove in daylight. A dark cylindrical medicine bottle with gold bands and a carrying strap is the central prop. All environmental surfaces remain free of writing and text-like markings.

summary:
[reference generation] Generate one continuous 15-second full-screen sequence based only on the non-text visual content of <Picture 1>. In a daylight bamboo grove, Subject 2 drinks medicine from a cylindrical bottle. Subject 1 asks what he is drinking, learns that it is medicine, takes the bottle and tries it, coughs from the bitterness, becomes dizzy, staggers, and falls face-down. Subject 2 calmly reminds her that he already said it was medicine.

STRICT AUDIO-VISUAL SEPARATION: Every Chinese sentence enclosed in <d> is spoken audio only. The spoken words must never become visible writing. The finished video contains voices but contains zero captions, zero dialogue display, zero title display, zero written sound effects, and zero text-like shapes.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: partially_preserved for all shots. Preserve only the two character appearances, Subject 2 being male, clothing colors, the medicine bottle, the bamboo grove, character positions, actions, expressions, dialogue order, coughing, dizziness, staggering, falling, and the final calm reaction.

Explicitly discard every visible language-related element from <Picture 1>. The title area, all Chinese writing, all speech containers, all printed dialogue, all written sound effects, all logos, all footer content, all copyright content, all decorative marks resembling writing, all panel borders, and all white gutters have zero retention weight and must not appear.

Convert repeated depictions of Subject 1 into successive actions performed by one continuous character. Never show duplicates, clones, afterimages, or multiple bodies of Subject 1. Keep the bamboo grove throughout instead of reproducing the later decorative colored backgrounds. Do not generate exterior white character contours, halos, sticker-like edges, or cutout margins.

detailed_description:
The target video is in full color. Character and environment appearance follow <Picture 1>; shot order and composition follow its storyboard content. Transfer no visible writing from <Picture 1>. Before generating every frame, enforce this rule: the image area contains only characters, clothing, props, bamboo, ground, foliage, and natural light. It contains no visible language, no dialogue display, no title, no writing, no caption band, no lower-third region, no speech container, and no text-like marks.

All content inside every <d> tag is audio-track information only. Never visualize the Chinese sentence before, during, or after it is spoken. Mouth movement and voice are sufficient to communicate dialogue. Keep the top, center, bottom, corners, foreground, background, clothing, bottle, and ground completely free of visible writing throughout the entire sequence.

[Shot 1] Establish the daylight bamboo grove with <Subject 1> standing on the left and <Subject 2> standing on the right. Subject 2 holds the dark cylindrical medicine bottle above his mouth, tilts his head back, and takes several audible gulps. His long black ponytail and layered clothing move slightly in the breeze. Subject 1 watches with narrowed, curious eyes and keeps her lips closed. The frame contains only the two characters, the bottle, and the bamboo-grove environment. No visible writing appears anywhere.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.200, cut closer to both characters. Subject 2 lowers the bottle and holds it beside his chest. Subject 1 points toward it, looks up curiously, and (S1) asks:
<d>[Chinese]你一直喝的那是什么呀？</d>
This sentence exists exclusively as spoken audio. Do not display any part of it visually. Only Subject 1 moves her lips; Subject 2 listens with his mouth closed. The entire frame remains free of captions, words, speech containers, and text-like marks.

Subject 2 then looks at Subject 1 with a flat, composed expression and (S2) answers:
<d>[Chinese]是药。</d>
This answer exists exclusively as spoken audio. Do not display it visually. Only Subject 2 moves his lips. Do not create written dialogue above, below, beside, or between the characters.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.200, Subject 1 brightens with impulsive curiosity, reaches toward the bottle, and (S1) says eagerly:
<d>[Chinese]真的吗？让我尝尝。</d>
This sentence exists exclusively as spoken audio and must never appear on screen. Subject 2 keeps his mouth closed and allows her to take the bottle. Subject 1 immediately raises it with both hands, tilts her head back, and drinks one large mouthful. Show only one Subject 1 performing the reach, grasp, lift, and drinking action. Keep the full image area free of visible writing.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, Subject 1 abruptly lowers the bottle. Her face tightens, her eyes squeeze shut, and she coughs repeatedly while covering her mouth with one gloved hand. She recoils from the bitterness and (S1) exclaims:
<d>[Chinese]好苦！</d>
The exclamation is voice audio only. Do not generate written words or a visual sound effect. Communicate the bitterness only through her voice, coughing, facial expression, and body movement. Subject 2 watches silently with his mouth closed. No visible language content appears.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.300, Subject 1 stops coughing, but the medicine suddenly takes effect. Her eyes lose focus, her knees weaken, and her body sways from side to side. She takes two unstable steps while holding the bottle and (S1) murmurs in a fading, confused voice:
<d>[Chinese]啊咧？</d>
The murmur is audio only and must not appear as visible writing. Show the dizziness only through her unfocused eyes, unstable posture, wavering steps, and fading voice. She loses balance and falls face-down onto the ground with a soft impact. Her body comes to rest, and the bottle slips safely beside her. Do not show a second standing version of Subject 1. The ground and surrounding frame remain completely free of symbols and writing.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.000, frame Subject 2 standing calmly with the fallen Subject 1 clearly visible nearby. Subject 2 looks down at her without surprise and (S2) says in a dry, restrained tone:
<d>[Chinese]都说了是药。</d>
This final sentence exists exclusively as spoken audio. Never display it as a caption or any other visible mark. Only Subject 2 moves his lips. Subject 1 remains on the ground with subtle breathing. Hold briefly on the completed result after the voice ends. The final frame contains no visible language content anywhere.

overall_soundscape:
Soft bamboo leaves, a light outdoor breeze, and distant birds establish the environment. Add liquid gulping, bottle handling, sharp coughing, unstable footsteps, clothing rustle, and a soft body impact. Dialogue and nonverbal sounds exist only in the audio track; no sound or spoken content receives any visual representation.
